scatter_method.description: Each spore is a seed. Plant it anywhere. The sourdough culture does the rest.
scatter_method.how_to_plant: Pick a spore. Fork the repo. Build it. Credit the source via sweetGrass. Push it back through a pre-citation issue. The spore becomes a project. The project becomes a plank. The plank becomes part of the ship.
scatter_method.backscatter: Every planted spore credits Album 1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23600707) and its data sources. The credit flows BACKWARD through sweetGrass PROV-O. The backscatter IS the pollination.
scatter_method.pi_sort_key: rational spores = buildable today with existing tech. fold spores = require a perspective shift. irrational spores = can't be built, only experienced.
